name: Destatis GENESIS API
tagline: Official German federal statistics via GENESIS-Online web service
description: The Destatis GENESIS API (Webservice) provides programmatic access to official statistics from the German Federal Statistical Office (Statistisches Bundesamt). Developers can query table data, metadata, time series, and statistical results from GENESIS-Online using REST-style and SOAP endpoints with username/password or token authentication.

auth.details: Username/password or temporary token via query params or form fields; free registration on GENESIS-Online required for full access

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free registration; usage limits apply (verify current quotas)

use_cases: fetch official German population statistics by table ID
query time series for economic indicators from Destatis
list available statistical tables and metadata
export regional statistical data as JSON or CSV
look up variable classifications and regional keys
